payload.reason: The evidence indicates that additional fine-tuning on CLIP was not included in the experiments due to poor performance compared to using extracted features for classification, likely stemming from a small labeled dataset.

claims.text: Fine-tuning CLIP with a classification head performed worse than using extracted features for classification with SVM due to a relatively smaller sized labeled dataset.
The small labeled dataset was insufficient for effective fine-tuning of CLIP for the task.
